description: The plot illustrates the training loss curves for different configurations of the SepLLM model during post-training, alongside a baseline “Vanilla before post-training” curve for comparison. The x-axis, labeled “#Iteration,” spans from approximately 95,000 to 125,000 iterations, with major gridlines at intervals of 5,000. The y-axis, labeled “Loss,” ranges from 2.0 to 3.0, with major gridlines at intervals of 0.2. Four distinct curves are shown: a pink solid line representing “SepLLM (n=64, larger lr)” starts near 3.0 at 95,000 iterations and declines steadily to approximately 2.22 by 125,000 iterations; a dark blue solid line for “SepLLM (n=128)” begins slightly below 3.0 and decreases to about 2.28; an orange solid line for “SepLLM (n=64)” starts near 3.0 and ends around 2.26; and a red dashed horizontal line for “Vanilla before post-training” remains constant at approximately 2.35 across all iterations. All SepLLM variants exhibit a consistent downward trend in loss, with the pink curve achieving the lowest final loss, while the vanilla baseline remains flat and higher than the post-trained models’ final values.
